notes.title: Update note v1.0.3
notes.content:
v1.0.3 Aug. 12, 2021


Added progress saving when step to camp
Added exclamation notice when there's unlockable recipe or BGM
Added tips for tutorials
Updated redeem rate when gameover
Updated generation possibility of sorcerer for level 1
Updated drop possibility of spells for chest
Improved in-game shop NPC, he takes over your second-hand items now
Improved notice for "almost broken" equipment
Improved usability of the buttons

notes.title: Patch note v1.0.1
notes.content:
